root_cause.text: Missing cleanup of access_pattern subdirectories in the error handling path of damon_sysfs_scheme_add_dirs() when subsequent operations fail after access_pattern directory setup succeeds.
root_cause.evidence: The patch shows that when damos_sysfs_set_dests() fails (line 2154-2155), the error handling path was jumping to `put_access_pattern_out` label which only called kobject_put() without first removing the subdirectories created under access_pattern/. The fix adds a call to `damon_sysfs_access_pattern_rm_dirs(scheme->access_pattern)` before the kobject_put() to properly clean up those subdirectories. The CVE description explicitly states: "subdirectories of access_pattern/ directory are not cleaned up" and "the memory for the unremoved directory is leaked," which is resolved by adding the missing damon_sysfs_access_pattern_rm_dirs() cleanup call in the error path.
